bull.b: FDA alignment on a novel surrogate endpoint and acceptance of a rolling BLA establish a defined regulatory pathway for nomlabofusp. This can shorten the route toward a potential accelerated approval and provides a clearer framework for advancing the lead program.

Longer-term data combining sustained frataxin increases, directional clinical improvement, and generally manageable safety support the biological rationale for nomlabofusp. Continued evidence across open-label and Phase 3 studies could strengthen the program’s development and commercial foundation.

Cash and marketable securities of $156.3 million, with projected funding into the third quarter of 2027, provide resources to advance the confirmatory Phase 3 study and regulatory work. This runway supports execution through important clinical and approval milestones.

bear.b: Zero revenue leaves Larimar dependent on clinical development success rather than established commercial cash generation. Until a product is approved and launched, the company has limited operating income to offset research, regulatory, and potential commercialization costs.

Accelerating operating cash burn increases the funding required to sustain trials and prepare for potential launch. Even with projected runway, deeply negative free cash flow means future milestones remain dependent on preserving liquidity and securing adequate financing.

Large and widening losses are eroding returns on equity and weakening the company’s financial performance despite modest debt. Continued negative profitability can pressure equity value over time and reduce flexibility in funding the business’s long development cycle.
